card.title: Assigned by Procedure
card.instruction: Get someone to accept an unwanted responsibility by proving that the rules, rotation, or tradition make it theirs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's your bin night. The rota puts you on Tuesdays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And I took your Thursday. The swap box says 'one week only.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At your request, so I couldn't keep your easy Thursday. It protects your Tuesday too.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 rota assigns Tuesday; A3 one-week swap clause and A5 B's requested protection establish the procedural obligation.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 covering last week prompts A3 reciprocal swap and limit; B4 A added box prompts A5 B requested it.

relationship.evidence: B2 claims earned exemption and B4 challenges authorship, forcing A to justify the rule's legitimacy.

heightening.evidence: B4 attacks the rule as self-serving; A5 shows it protected B's easy day and now also returns the unwanted one.
